description: Remove a manga entry from the authenticated user's list. This cannot be undone. Returns `deleted: true` whenever MAL accepts the request — including when the manga was never on the list to begin with, since MAL's own delete endpoint doesn't distinguish the two — so success alone isn't proof something existed; check get_my_manga_list first if you need to confirm. Requires a MyAnimeList login.

manga_id.description: MyAnimeList numeric ID of the target entry. (The read tools call this same id `id`; it's named anime_id/manga_id here to match MAL's own write endpoints.) Obtain it from search_anime/search_manga, or from get_my_anime_list/get_my_manga_list for an entry already on your list.

name: delete_my_manga_list_item
title: Remove manga from my list
